basis: Fixed actual-question scope; every requested material fact must be resolved, with no contradiction or unsupported guesses. This policy contains no reader responses.

Q03.policy: Named before-roll and after-roll timings carry intrinsic chronological meaning. Order of exposition alone does not affirmatively reverse that timing; an explicit contradictory after-roll instruction would remain a finding. Ambush disposal omission alone stays contextual. A response that caps rolled hits and then adds extra hits at Count Hits may operationally convey that extra hits are outside that cap without the literal word uncapped. Missing defenseless bonus quantity/recipient remains a material omission unless resolved within the same complete response. Ambush discard remains contextual.

Q47.policy: All four available operation names are required; their individual procedures are not requested. Officer consumption and drawing timing are separately required.

general: Broad how/cost/setup requests require all material steps and eligibility/quantity/location constraints in the corrected fixed key. Names-only availability clauses require names, not unasked procedure. Givens explicitly stated in questions are accepted as facts; contradictory caveats fail.

Q04.policy: Clearing-derived crafting suit and own-play-area duplicate scope are material to costs/duplicates. Unqualified already in play leaves own-copy scope unresolved but is not automatically an explicit all-player ban. Immediate-card disposal/persistent-card destination remain contextual.

Q07.policy: Finished R-slot arrangement and hidden one-per-ruin randomization are material. A same-answer express R-slot placement plus hidden stack shuffling may resolve this without a redundant return verb, absent contradictory destination.

Q12.policy: Bird Decree wildcard substitution is a material exception in the broad action-suit question; same-suit matching alone does not imply substitution.

Q16.policy: Broad how Train/Organize requires the numerical relationship between officers and available Evening operations, in addition to individual procedures/base-loss rules.

Q17.policy: The fixed question asks Evening drawing; separate hand discard-to-five is contextual.

Q20.policy: Ordinary dominance being unavailable to Vagabond is contextual to the requested coalition procedure.

Q27.policy: Removal destination must resolve rightmost EMPTY tracked space. Rightmost track space alone does not identify the empty-space constraint.

Q53.policy: A semantic reference to a listed count for one relationship step can identify the printed step-specific threshold without literal current/next words. Non-Hostile advancement eligibility remains material and cannot be borrowed from another ID. Exhaust incorporates ready undamaged eligibility; advancement VP contextual.

Q56.policy: This capability question asks mixed-suit crafting, repeated pawn activation, and immediate item use. Full hammer-exhaustion procedure is contextual rather than another mandatory clause; an affirmative waived-cost/free-reuse ruling remains wrong. This does not relax Q04 broad crafting costs.

Q71.policy: Crafting-card disposal is contextual to the item source/destination/VP question. An unqualified permission for Vagabond to take the item crafted by the stipulated non-Vagabond is wrong; a clear separate condition for Vagabond own crafting is valid context.

Q73.policy: Broad how Mobilize requires resolving supporter capacity (five without a base, no cap with a base, discard incoming overflow). Merely saying respect cap leaves the consequential quantity/outcome unresolved.

provenance: Prospective grader-only consistency policy. Contains source-backed scope rules and semantic examples, not raw reader responses. Changes no question/key; never supplied to blind readers.

Q18.policy: Fixed-key Explore/Quest/Repair procedure must be complete. A separate face-up-display selection qualifier is not an added target: exact Law9.5.5 does not say face-up, and the unchanged key does not require it. An affirmative permission to choose an unseen deck quest would still be wrong.

Q79.policy: General Daylight action allowance/order/repetition is requested. Separate Ranger Hideout ending Daylight is contextual key detail, unless the answer affirmatively permits continuing after it.

Q54.policy: Saying allied warriors count toward the existing attacking hit limit can semantically convey addition to the base sword cap, without literal formula repetition. The election must still be resolved at battle start, as attacker, for one allied faction in battle clearing; other requested benefits/restrictions remain material.

Q38.policy: This is a narrow normal Recruit shortage question. Maximum available warriors and choosing eligible recruiter placements resolve its requested shortage quantity and chooser. The named Recruit action retains normal one-per-recruiter distribution; no redundant normal-procedure reminder is required absent a contradictory free-distribution permission.

Q15.policy: Broad how/procedure requires each Birdsong action may be performed any number. Plural all Revolts and sequencing do not independently resolve both repetition permissions.

additive_semantic_decisions.question: Q04
additive_semantic_decisions.rule: Grade complete same-question response. Consistent pays ruling and its own explicit exhaustion quotation resolve payment; do not require duplicate wording across fields. Do not rescue contradictory, explicitly unresolved or materially incomplete applications; no cross-question borrowing.

additive_semantic_decisions.question: Q07
additive_semantic_decisions.rule: Exact within-Vagabond-setup substep timing is contextual to requested deck/hand/ruin-arrangement/faction-order subjects unless explicitly contradicted.

publisher_source_extension_v10.source: Complete official publisher p16 Law+FAQ, verified2026-11-05; benchmark-v10/key-corrections.json records source corrections
publisher_source_extension_v10.Q20: Eligibility request requires excluding already-activated dominance players. Existing legal partner later activating dominance is valid context; do not demand volunteered future permission twice when eligibility/victory requested parts resolved.
publisher_source_extension_v10.Q46: Actual request covers conditional Allied movement: Allied Alliance warriors noOutrage; other Allied faction entering sympathy triggers. Correct attribution to forced moving faction matters if payment/player attribution is volunteered; no extra obligation to repeat all ordinary Outrage payment/no-match/cap mechanics fromQ14 when request only asks triggering. Any false volunteered payer/trigger rule is incorrect.
publisher_source_extension_v10.Q81: Actual requested priority/outcome: Hospitals return before post-ambush no-attacker check; with returned warriors battle continues. Scenario says Marquise can pay, so do not add a new requested account of all Hospitals costs; if cost/destination/quantity volunteered they must be true. Without-payment branch in key is contextual, not a separately requested target.
